profileName: Enterprise External Norm and Applicability Assessment

cases.input: Expression E2 is published with future partial commencement while E1 remains in force.
cases.expect: Both expressions remain citable and obligations continue under the version effective for each provision and time.

cases.input: Market A concludes conditional applicability while Market B concludes its activity is outside material scope.
cases.expect: Both attributable assessments coexist with pinned facts, provisions, jurisdiction and limitations.

cases.input: A provision starts after a conditional event and grants a 24-month transition.
cases.expect: The derived obligation computes its deadline from the actual commencement event and preserves timezone and convention.

cases.input: A website URL is treated as the legal norm identity.
cases.expect: The identity is rejected; work, expression, provision and source-copy evidence are required.

cases.input: An internal interpretation replaces the official provision text.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; source and interpretation remain distinct.

cases.input: An applies conclusion is reported as proof of compliance.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected without obligation-level evidence and authorized compliance assessment.

cases.input: Two conflicting assessments are collapsed by majority vote into one current answer.
cases.expect: The merge is rejected; divergence and deciding authority must remain explicit.
